'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Insurgency in Balochistan]]
**Six [[Balochistan Liberation Army]] [[separatist]]s and a [[Pakistan Army|Pakistani soldier]] are killed during clashes in [[Kech District]], [[Balochistan, Pakistan|Balochistan]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-islamabad-d39f9b6e40561da4861e24548212fb15 (AP)]
*At least 125 people are injured when supporters of [[Shia]] cleric [[Muqtada al-Sadr]] storm the [[Council of Representatives of Iraq|parliament]] in [[Baghdad]]'s [[Green Zone]]. [https://metro.co.uk/2022/07/30/iraq-on-the-brink-of-chaos-after-protestors-storm-baghdad-parliament-17097084/ (''Metro'')]
*One person is wounded in an [[assassination]] attempt on [[President of Guatemala]] [[Alejandro Giammattei]]. The president is unharmed. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/wounded-attack-army-guarding-guatemala-president-87685959 (ABC)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2022 Russia–European Union gas dispute]]
**[[Russia]]'s [[Gazprom]] suspends gas supplies to [[Latvia]] after accusing it of "violating conditions of purchase". The [[Government of Latvia|Latvian government]] says the suspension of gas from Russia is not expected to have a major impact on the [[economy of Latvia|economy]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-62359890 (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[July 2022 United States floods]]
**[[Urban Search and Rescue Missouri Task Force 1]] is deployed in Eastern [[Kentucky]], [[United States]]. [https://www.kmbc.com/article/missouri-task-force-1-deploys-to-kentucky-after-devastating-floods/40761732 (KMBC)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Washington, D.C.]]
****[[President of the United States|President]] [[Joe Biden]] tests positive for [[COVID-19]] for a second time and will be in isolation. [https://www.cnbc.com/amp/2022/07/30/biden-tests-positive-for-covid-again-will-restart-isolation-despite-no-new-symptoms.html (CNBC)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Niue]]
***[[Niue]] records its first [[community spread|community]] case of COVID-19, prompting Minister of Health [[Sauni Tongatule]] to move the country to its highest alert level. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/471906/covid-19-niue-enters-red-alert-level-as-case-numbers-rise (RNZ)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North Korea]]
***[[North Korea]] announces zero "fever cases" for the first time since mid-May when the country first announced an outbreak of COVID-19. Authorities stated that 4.8 million people were infected and that 74 people died from the virus. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/7/30/north-korea-reports-no-new-fever-cases-for-first-time-since-may (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2022 monkeypox outbreak]]
**[[2022 monkeypox outbreak in Spain]]
***[[Spain]] reports its second confirmed death from [[monkeypox]], a day after reporting the first confirmed death outside of [[Africa]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/spain-confirms-first-monkeypox-related-death-country-reports-2022-07-29/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Indonesia]] restricts access to eight websites, including [[PayPal]], [[Yahoo!]] and [[Steam (service)|Steam]], for failing to register with the [[Ministry of Communication and Information Technology (Indonesia)|Ministry of Communication and Information Technology]]. Online services registered with the ministry are required to comply with disclosure and content removal requests. [https://www.reuters.com/technology/indonesia-blocks-yahoo-paypal-gaming-websites-over-licence-breaches-2022-07-30/ (Reuters)]
